channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jacob Evans | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jacob Evans from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jacob Evans
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr on rookie Jacob Evans, who has been recalled from Santa Cruz:

“Like any young player, he just needs to learn the pro game. And the only way to do that is to get minutes. ... We plan on giving him more time down (in the G League) as it suits.”

Steve Kerr on Jacob Evans, Dec 23, 2018. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jacob Evans
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr on Jacob Evans, who got meaningful minutes last night in Brooklyn:

“He looks like he belongs out there.... I think he’s starting to come around.”

Steve Kerr on Jacob Evans, Oct 29, 2018. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jacob Evans
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr on Jacob Evans, who has yet to make his NBA debut with the Warriors:

“This isn't the YMCA. We don't have to play 15 guys all eight minutes apiece.... He's not doing anything wrong. He's just got people ahead of him right now.”

Steve Kerr on Jacob Evans, Oct 22, 2018. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Bob Myers on Jacob Evans
item.description:
Bob Myers on Jacob Evans:

“He's kind of the modern NBA wing. Versatile. Tough. We're excited we were able to get him.”

Bob Myers on Jacob Evans, Jun 22, 2018. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.
